# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This website holds the course logistics for
[CSCI 201](https://catalog.wwu.edu/search_advanced.php?cur_cat_oid=23&search_database=Search&search_db=Search&cpage=1&ecpage=1&ppage=1&spage=1&tpage=1&location=3&filter%5Bkeyword%5D=CSCI%20201),
"Discrete Math and Functional Programming for Computer Scientists",
as taught in Winter Quarter 2027
at [Western Washington University](https://www.wwu.edu/)
by [Douglas Ezra Morrison](https://d-morrison.github.io/).

- The [syllabus](chapters/syllabus.qmd) gives the course policies, grading and the week-by-week schedule.
- The [prerequisite self-test](chapters/prerequisite-self-test.qmd) checks the background the course assumes, before it starts.
- The [calendar](chapters/calendar.qmd) gives the day-by-day plan of lectures, labs and due dates.
- The [lecture notes](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/) are on their own site.

Canvas lists every due date and is the place to submit work.
